institutional-names-slower.title: Mentioning specific institutional or brand names predicts slower funding regardless of gender.
institutional-names-slower.body: Pitches that reference specific financial institutions or brands tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

professional-experience-faster.title: Mentioning specific years of professional experience predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
professional-experience-faster.body: Quantifying professional experience or tenure in a field accelerates the funding process for both men and women.

family-details-faster.title: Mentioning specific family details predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
family-details-faster.body: Pitches that provide concrete details about children or household stability accelerate funding for both men and women.

men-single-status-slower.title: Stating single marital status predicts slower funding for male borrowers.
men-single-status-slower.body: Male borrowers who explicitly identify as single tend to fund more slowly than those who do not.

female-future-savings-slower.body: Female borrowers mentioning dreams of saving for the future may fund slower.

male-brevity-faster.body: Shorter pitch texts may predict faster funding for male borrowers.

hardship-gender-interaction.body: Details regarding personal hardships may accelerate funding for women but slow it for men.

male-environmental-slower.body: Male borrowers who focus on environmental or ecological concerns may fund slower.

female-technical-outcomes-faster.body: Female borrowers who detail specific technical outcomes may fund faster.

women-assets-experience.title: Female borrowers who list specific assets or professional backgrounds may fund faster.
women-assets-experience.retrospective: Promoted and generalized to a gender-neutral claim after corroboration in male pairs.

men-family-wellbeing.title: Male borrowers who focus on children or family well-being may fund faster.
men-family-wellbeing.retrospective: Promoted to gender-general claim after corroboration in female pairs.

female-specific-ages-faster.title: Female borrowers who include specific ages for themselves or their children may fund faster.
female-specific-ages-faster.retrospective: Promoted to gender-general claim after corroboration in male pairs.

male-hardship-details-slower.title: Male borrowers who provide extensive details on location or personal hardships may fund slower.
male-hardship-details-slower.retrospective: Merged into interaction puzzle after conflicting evidence in female pairs.

men-marital-status.title: Male borrowers who explicitly state their marital status may see faster funding.
men-marital-status.retrospective: Promoted and refined to a specific claim about single status slowing funding.
